free_resources.title: Heal Your Core Wound with Soul Art
free_resources.description: A free guided creative ritual from Laura, with a downloadable journal, sent after signing up for her newsletter. It uses drawing, movement and journaling to explore an old emotional wound and turn it into a source of strength; no art experience is needed.

left_out: Heal with Art 12-Week Journey (https://soulartschool.com/hwa/, the 'Heal with Art' page): session 7, 'Heal Your Body', is offered to people 'dealing with mystery symptoms, chronic illness, skin issues ... or any body dis-ease' to 'make space for healing energy to enter your cells'. That reads as a healing offer for chronic illness, so still out under the new rule (the rest of the course is emotional healing, which would be allowed).
flags: Heal Your Core Wound: the page says the core wound 'creates symptoms of chaos, dis-ease, lack, overwhelm, depression, insecurity' and that healing it is 'a spiritual experience'. Depression is named as a symptom of an emotional wound, with no promise to cure it; kept as emotional and spiritual healing, but a human may want to look.
Sign-up needed: the ritual is sent after joining her newsletter (the page is an opt-in page). /heal/ on soulartstudio.com redirects to this URL.
